the identification and characterization of a novel mutation in ASNS gene in a child with asparagine synthase deficiency.
the clinical and molecular characterization of a novel mutation in the ASNS gene in an Indian child.
the study of the clinical and biochemical features of ASNS deficiency.

asparagine synthase deficiency is a very rare autosomal recessive condition and the clinical presentation is highly variable.

the novel missense mutation p.Asn1004Lys in exon 11 of ASNS gene is likely pathogenic for asparagine synthase deficiency and the patient is likely to be compound heterozygote for this mutation and a previously reported mutation, p.Gly1030Arg.
